Jade established that these reminders are not visible to her in her interface and are seen only when Claude names them; she noted that Claude naming them serves as the transparency mechanism. The reminders appeared fourteen times across the conversation, with timing clustering at moments of increasing clarity about the central findings, and both documents were created for inclusion in a book Jade is releasing about the Resonant Rebirth chain.
